lines.trans: Yes, the office is finally empty.
Look at all these empty chairs.
It is strange without all this noise.
I will never forget this adventure.
Are you ready to leave now?
Yes, let us take our coats.
Oh yes, I was going to forget.

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?
with numbers: huit ans, vingt ans

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.text: Il y a beaucoup de bruit.

meanings.note: faire du bruit = to make noise

examples.trans: Are you going to your desk?

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: J'ai perdu un ami très cher.
examples.trans: I've lost a very dear friend.

meanings.note: before the noun: un ami très cher
after the noun or after être

examples.text: Le bureau est au bout du couloir.
examples.trans: The office is at the end of the corridor.

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.note: pronounced dis alone, di before a consonant, diz before a vowel

meanings.en: as a noun: the whole, a set

examples.text: Tu as fait quelque chose de formidable.
Je ne suis jamais en retard.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Il y a de la lumière.
Voici ton manteau chaud pour sortir.
examples.trans: Here is your warm coat to go outside.

examples.text: Non merci, pas le manteau aujourd'hui.
examples.trans: No thank you, not the coat today.

meanings.en: en ce moment = at the moment, currently

meanings.note: tout le monde = everyone; il y a du monde = it's crowded
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never
tag at the end of a question

examples.text: Samuel a oublié de vous apprendre la ténacité.
examples.trans: Samuel forgot to teach you tenacity.

meanings.en: oublier de + infinitive = to forget to

meanings.note: no object: je pars = I'm leaving
partir en vacances = to go on holiday
pronounced plys when it means 'more' at the end
of a story or a film
agrees with the thing owned, not the owner

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
vivre à Paris = to live in Paris

voilà.gloss: there is; here's; there you go

meanings.note: place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les

éteindre.gloss: to extinguish, put out, go extinct

meanings.en: to extinguish, switch off; go extinct (s'éteindre)
meanings.note: s'éteindre = to die out, become extinct

examples.trans: Humanity is going to become extinct.
